question: The Mahakali Caves are a group of 19 rock cut monuments located in______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maharashtra__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mahakali Caves, also Kondivite Caves, are a group of 19 rock-cut monuments built between the 1st century BCE and the 6th century CE.
 
• This Buddhist monastery is located in the eastern suburb of Andheri in the city of Mumbai in western India
 
• The suburbs of Mumbai hide several groups of unique monuments – ancient rock-cut temples.
 
• One such monument is the ancient Kondivite Caves, later known as Mahakali caves. Mahakali caves are 19 rock-cut caves, built between the 1st century BC and the 6th century.
